## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Include a concrete example when useful.

## Validation

List the commands and results for this revision. Explain any required check that
could not run. Use [the validation guide](../docs/validation.md) for the check contract.

## Review notes

- Explain any intentional increase to a handwritten production file above 750 lines.
- Describe material security or lifecycle changes and their regression coverage.
- Confirm author and committer use the repository-approved email identity.
